selector.rationale: New left upper lobe opacification and diffuse reticulonodular interstitial prominence on chest radiograph and CT scan, consistent with Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia, especially in an HIV-positive patient with low CD4 count

rejected.label: Toxoplasmosis
rejected.why: Although toxoplasmosis was previously diagnosed and treated, the new respiratory symptoms and radiographic findings are more consistent with a different opportunistic infection

rejected.label: HIV-associated immune suppression
rejected.why: While HIV-associated immune suppression is a underlying condition, it is not a specific diagnosis for the current respiratory symptoms

rejected.label: Cytomegalovirus infection
rejected.why: There is limited evidence to support cytomegalovirus infection as the cause of the current respiratory symptoms
